name: Runner Tests Fixture - Failed Test Rollback Boundary
brief: Regression test: writes made by a [Test] that FAILS must not survive into the next [Test] of the same codeunit (#2757). Named ExpectedToFail_/Reporter_ throughout: two of the four tests fail BY DESIGN, and their names say so directly in CI output.
description: BC's NavTestCodeunit.ExecuteTestMethodAsync wraps every test method in `catch (Exception ex) { if (activeSession.IsTransactionActive()) activeSession.Rollback(); MarkExceptions(ex); }`, so a failing test's uncommitted writes are undone before the next test runs, while a PASSING test's writes are committed and do survive. This fixture pins both halves. Two of its four tests -- both named ExpectedToFail_NN_... -- fail BY DESIGN; FailedTestRollbackBoundaryTests.cs asserts their exact procedure names and messages, so a FAIL line here always reads as intended in CI output rather than as a broken fixture (see #2739, the reason this is spelled out rather than left implicit).
